items.title: Brazil ex-president Jair Bolsonaro taken to hospital over abdominal pain
items.excerpt: Jair Bolsonaro has been hospitalized in Brasilia with intestinal obstruction. The former far-right Brazilian leader is receiving pain medications, his son Carlos said.

items.title: UK anti-migrant activist jailed for slashing Channel dinghy
items.excerpt: Daniel Thomas, known as "Danny Tommo," slashed a dinghy with a knife while a French rescue worker was on board. The incident was livestreamed to a large social media audience amid growing tensions over migrant crossings.
